ARTIFACTS.description: Cloudflare Artifacts namespace `codemode-git`, one git repo per agent. Create it first with `npx cf artifacts namespaces create --namespace codemode-git`.

LOADER.description: Worker Loader that runs the model's code in a sandboxed Dynamic Worker.

AGENT.description: Durable Object, one per agent. Holds the Code Mode runtime and the commit outbox.

AI.description: Workers AI. `ask` uses it for the chat model and for the embeddings that find other agents' runs.

EXAMPLES.description: Vectorize index `codemode-git-examples` (1024 dimensions, cosine) of answer-producing runs. Needs metadata indexes on `scope` (string), `ok` (boolean) and `task` (string); see the repo README.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Requests must send `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>`. **Set this**: the Worker runs arbitrary code it is sent.
